posts.body:
Hello. I just found out that I'm expecting twins as well. Due date likely around end March / early April. Very overwhelmed at the moment now given the surprise! 

I was wondering whether anyone is expecting identical twins or fraternal twins. I'm at 7 weeks and it seems like I have both in one placenta but haven't been able to see a membrane yet and the doctor says its too early to see. I'm also trying to see if there are any doctors who have a lot of experience with twins who is willing to deliver in a Kowloon private hospital. 

I'd love to meet and get to know everyone better. Any support would be awesome!
